name: Wedding Car Rental
shortDescription: Decorated car with a dressed driver for baraat, vidaai and reception. Sedan, SUV and luxury options.
fullDescription: Book a flower-decorated car for the groom's baraat, the bride's vidaai or the reception drive. Pick a sedan for a simple, neat look, an SUV like Innova Crysta or Fortuner for more presence, or a luxury car for a grand entry. We fix the decoration theme with you before the day. faqs.question: How early should I book?

faqs.question: Do I need to pay an advance?

faqs.question: Who pays tolls and parking?
faqs.answer: You do, at actual cost. The driver will show receipts.

faqs.question: Can you send the car to a wedding outside Patna?
faqs.answer: Yes. Outstation weddings are billed per km plus a daily driver allowance, and the decoration is done before departure.

faqs.question: Can I change the pickup time?

faqs.question: Can I pay in cash?

shortDescription: Photographers and videographers for weddings, pre-wedding shoots, tilak, birthdays and family functions in Patna.
fullDescription: Book a photo and video team for your wedding day, pre-wedding shoot or family function. Choose plain traditional coverage, or add candid photos and a short cinematic film. faqs.question: Is each function priced separately?

faqs.question: When do we get photos and video?

faqs.question: Can you shoot with a drone?

faqs.question: What is the difference between candid and traditional?
faqs.answer: Traditional means posed group photos and full ritual coverage. Candid means natural, unposed moments. Most families book both.

faqs.question: How much advance do we pay?
faqs.answer: A part payment blocks the date; the rest is due on or before the event. Exact split is set at booking.

faqs.question: Do you cover weddings outside Patna?

faqs.question: When does setup start and who removes it?

faqs.question: Can I see the design before booking?

faqs.question: How early should we book?

faqs.question: Do I pay TiptoBook or the venue?

faqs.question: Do you cover venues outside Patna city?

faqs.question: Does the pandit fix the muhurat?

faqs.question: Can I give extra dakshina?
faqs.answer: You may give extra dakshina or daan by custom. It is your choice and is not required by TiptoBook.

faqs.question: Is there a charge to change the date?

faqs.question: Do you do pind daan at Gaya?

faqs.question: How many days off does the helper get?

faqs.question: Can I change tasks later?

faqs.question: What if I am not happy with the helper?

faqs.question: What does the live-in attendant need from us?

faqs.question: Can I book for just a few days after hospital discharge?
faqs.answer: Yes. Daily billing is available; monthly plans cost less per day.

faqs.question: What if the caregiver takes leave?

name: Home CCTV Setup
shortDescription: Wired CCTV fitting for your house with DVR, hard disk and live view on your phone.

faqs.question: Can I give my own cameras?

faqs.question: Which brand should I pick?

faqs.question: How many days of recording will I get?
faqs.answer: It depends on hard disk size, number of cameras and resolution. A 1 TB disk with 4 HD cameras usually holds roughly 2–3 weeks; the technician will show the exact figure.

faqs.question: Will I see the cameras on my phone?
faqs.answer: Yes, if the DVR is connected to your Wi-Fi router or internet line. We install the brand app and add the device for you.

faqs.question: Does it work during power cuts?
faqs.answer: Not by itself. Add a small UPS or inverter connection to keep the DVR and cameras running.

faqs.question: Do you do hidden wiring?
faqs.answer: Yes, after a site check. Concealed wiring needs wall chasing and is quoted per metre.

faqs.question: Do you repair systems installed by someone else?

faqs.question: What does the AMC cover?

The price covers the frame, boards, joint finishing and primer, with light cut-outs. LED panels, cove strips and wiring for them are quoted per point. Most single rooms are finished within a few days, and debris is cleared after work.

faqs.question: How is the area measured?
faqs.answer: By the ceiling area in square feet. Cove designs and drops may add running-foot charges, which are listed in the quote.

faqs.question: Gypsum or POP: which is better?
faqs.answer: Gypsum is faster and smoother with less mess. POP suits curved or detailed designs but takes longer to set and finish.

faqs.question: Can I use false ceiling in the bathroom?
faqs.answer: PVC panels are a better choice for bathrooms and balconies because they resist moisture. Gypsum needs a moisture-resistant board there.

faqs.question: Are lights included?
faqs.answer: The price includes cut-outs for lights. Fixtures and wiring points are charged separately so you can pick your own brand.

faqs.question: Is painting included?
faqs.answer: Primer is included. The final paint coat is quoted separately unless your package says otherwise.

faqs.question: Will it reduce room height?
faqs.answer: Usually by a few inches, depending on design. The technician checks your ceiling height during the visit.

fullDescription: A supervisor visits your home, checks walls, plumbing, waterproofing and wiring, and notes what you want to change. Bathrooms often need new waterproofing and pipelines in homes older than 10–15 years, so these are checked first. Kitchens can be refreshed with new tiles, granite and a sink, or fully remodelled with modular units. Full-home jobs can bundle painting, flooring, ceilings and electrical upgrades.

faqs.question: Do I need to vacate the house?
faqs.answer: Not for a single bathroom or kitchen job. For full-home renovation, staying elsewhere for part of the time is often easier.

faqs.question: Why do old bathrooms cost more?
faqs.answer: Homes older than 10–15 years often need new waterproofing and plumbing lines, which adds labour and material cost.

faqs.question: Can I supply my own tiles and fittings?
faqs.answer: Yes. The quote then covers labour and civil materials only, and you control brand and price.

faqs.question: Is there a warranty?
faqs.answer: Workmanship and waterproofing cover terms are written in your quote.

faqs.question: How is the final price fixed?
faqs.answer: After the site visit, you get an itemised quote. Extra work found during demolition is shown and approved by you before it is done.

name: Full Home Painting
shortDescription: Repaint or fresh-paint your whole flat or house in Patna, priced by area after a site measurement.
fullDescription: Our painting team visits, measures the walls and ceilings, checks for damp and cracks, and gives a written quote per square foot. You pick the paint grade: economy, premium or luxury emulsion from Asian Paints, Berger, Nerolac or Birla Opus. The price covers furniture covering, light sanding, crack filling, one coat of primer and two top coats. Fresh homes also get two coats of wall putty. Exterior walls are quoted separately because they need weather-grade paint and sometimes scaffolding. Most 2 BHK interiors finish in 4–6 working days.

faqs.question: How do you calculate the price?
faqs.answer: We measure every wall and ceiling to be painted, minus large doors and windows, and multiply by the per-sq-ft rate of your paint grade. You get the breakup in writing before work starts.

faqs.question: Is the inspection visit free?
faqs.answer: The visit is free inside Patna city limits. Outside, a small travel charge applies and is adjusted against the final bill if you book.

faqs.question: Can I buy the paint myself?
faqs.answer: Yes, we can do labour-only at a lower rate. You then own any shade mismatch or shortage, so we suggest letting us source it.

faqs.question: How long does a 2 BHK take?
faqs.answer: Usually 4–6 working days for interiors, depending on wall condition, putty work and drying time between coats.

faqs.question: Do you fix damp walls?
faqs.answer: Painting over damp only peels again. We point out seepage during the visit and quote waterproofing separately before painting.

faqs.question: Do I need to empty the rooms?
faqs.answer: No. We move light furniture to the centre and cover it. Please pack fragile items and wall hangings beforehand.

name: Room-by-Room Painting
shortDescription: Paint just one wall, one room or a few rooms, including texture or accent walls, at a fixed starting price.
fullDescription: Not every home needs a full repaint. Book us for a single wall, a bedroom, the kitchen, a bathroom or a balcony. The painter covers your furniture, scrapes loose paint, fills small cracks, applies primer and two coats in the shade you pick. For a feature look, choose an accent wall in a bold colour or a texture finish such as rustic, sand or stencil designs. Small jobs finish in a day; a full room usually takes two days because each coat needs to dry. Final price is confirmed on site if the wall is larger or damaged.

faqs.question: What if my room is bigger than the package?
faqs.answer: The painter measures before starting. Extra area is charged at the same per-sq-ft rate, and you approve the new total before work begins.

faqs.question: Can you match my existing wall colour?
faqs.answer: Yes, if you share the shade name or code. Otherwise we match by eye using shade cards; an exact match on old, faded paint is not guaranteed.

faqs.question: How long before I can use the room?
faqs.answer: Emulsion is touch-dry in a few hours. Keep furniture off the walls for a day and avoid washing the wall for about two weeks.

faqs.question: What textures can I choose?
faqs.answer: Common options are rustic, sand, stucco-look, combing and stencil patterns. The painter brings a sample catalogue; complex designer finishes cost more.

faqs.question: Is there a smell?
faqs.answer: We use low-odour water-based emulsions by default. Keep windows open; most people sleep in the room the next night.
